facts.fact: The planning ministry's status report on its Information Infrastructure Center says 4,666 health offices are electronically linked under the births and deaths systems project, and that 2,000 health offices had their operating capacity raised with devices and equipment; it gives no total of health offices and no date other than the report's own.
